SDS_Stardust_Station.name: Stardust Station
SDS_Stardust_Station.text: Bright, maintained, livable workplace space station: clean readable sci-fi surfaces, ordinary offices/break rooms/corridors, colorful institutional signage and corporate optimism with absurd cracks. Workplace comedy first. No grimdark, rusty dystopia, industrial grime, sacred-crystal framing, crystal mysticism or generic hard-sci-fi spectacle.
